correctness.rationale: The 5x5 Fourier Gram has exact trigonometric moments. At antipodal placement parity blocks yield the simple smallest eigenvalue L-sy. For any other separation the trial-plane shifted determinant equals s^2 t^2(A+t^2D); all parameter ranges are covered by strict Bernstein-sign certificates, so a lower Rayleigh quotient exists. The checker reconstructs determinant identities algebraically, their strict bounds, and independently diagonalizes 3131 cases. Endpoints and normalization are stated explicitly.

broader_coverage.reasoning: The all-band result addresses only the limit as the arc width tends to zero for band two; finite-width optimality is explicitly restricted to band one. Broader real-line localization operator theorems bound intermediate-eigenvalue counts, not this sharp parameterized finite-dimensional extremum.

value.rationale: This exact maximization of the weakest observed Fourier energy is a natural two-window spectral sensing invariant. Prior work establishes the universal short-arc asymptotic and a three-mode finite-width case, but not the next odd band at arbitrary positive width. The exact radical and strict optimal placement give a complete finite-parameter resolution, not a narrow arbitrary numeric slice. No assertion is made for larger bands.
